# Synthetic M1 fixtures

Created locally for SmartWorks PDF on 2026-10-06 using solid colour rectangles; no real photographs or user documents. The eight JPEGs share a 120 × 80 four-colour raster and carry EXIF orientation values 1–8. Red/green/blue JPEGs test order; corners.png tests rotation; alpha.png tests transparency; benchmark-2mp.jpg is a synthetic 2000 × 1000 raster, not a claim about all real photo complexity. Pillow was used as a development tool, not added to application dependencies.
